huntObservations.hunt3_wordcount: v3 6462 -> v5 6127 (-5.2%). Cuts taken from restated beats, duplicate sensory beats (tack creaking, wind whine, violet/well-fed, arms folded), and trailing explanation clauses.
hunt4_hitlist: Dialogue register: no zero-tolerance terms found (actionable, vector, substrate, propagation, ingested, concentration, etc.). 'frontier allotment', 'ranked', 'impounded', 'kit' read as in-world Farstrider/military speech and were kept.
Verbose phrases (the sensation was, the act of, the result was, etc.): none present.
Negation: 'Not that it's true' (Sylvanas, dialogue) and 'Nothing chipped, nothing leaning' kept as speech and list rhythm. No triple, preamble, or negated-anthropomorphic constructions in narration.
Actor demotion: one hit ('Her eyes held on each one'), fixed. 'The mare's head came up' and 'her breastbone went cold' kept as involuntary or animal reflex.
Staged ambience: no 'From X came Y' inversions. 'Above her a thrush tried a few notes' names its source and was kept.

Planner shorthand: 'Which left going in herself.' kept because it cashes out in the next line (go and find a reason to trust her) and in the options laid out just above it. No 'enough to work with' style placeholders.
Abstract-noun locomotion: none. 'Her face went hot' and 'muscles ... drew tight' are body-first.
Something-cap (2): 'something large deciding' and 'set something down' retained; 'Something in her things' cut.
Breath-reaction cap (3): 'breathed out through her teeth', 'drew breath to speak', Theris's gasping report (injury of exertion, not tell). Within cap.
Simile cap: 'as though' x2, 'as if' x1 (idiom), narration 'like' similes 1 (ship's officer's coat); Cyndia's cask 'like' is dialogue. Within cap.
Eye/gaze beats: 'looked back' (troll), 'kept them on Sylvanas', dialogue 'Eyes south' and 'They always look back'. Count under cap of 4 in narration.
Participial clusters: one cluster at the canter (someone cursing, tack creaking, hoof striking stone) reduced. Other paragraphs run 1-2.
Sentence-opener monotony and paragraph cadence: paragraph lengths vary from one-line (No. / Which left going in herself.) to nine-sentence blocks; no change needed.
Elegant variation: 'the mage' / 'the woman' / 'the human' used for Jaina from Sylvanas's POV; kept after her name is learned because Sylvanas withholds trust. One clarity fix at L329.
Scene-break markers: none present in v3.
hunt5_dialogue: Theris: report fragments with 'Breath.' beats kept; clipped Farstrider register fits voice and situation.
Lor'themar: ironic, courtly, full sentences ('I was about to observe') fits trusted-elf register on the sheet; no document voice.
Cyndia: plain post-commander speech; 'not ranked' is rank-idiom. Cask comparison trimmed to a single simile.
Sylvanas: command shorthand to subordinates ('Mount up' is Lor'themar's; hers are 'Report.', 'Her name.', 'Start talking.'). Voice-sheet match confirmed; no softening added.
No 'say it plainly' / 'short version' fake-simplification exchanges exist in this chapter.
